Field.Label: Battery device threshold (hours)
Field.Description: Alert if a battery-powered Z-Wave device has not communicated for this many hours.

Field.Label: Mains device threshold (hours) — RETIRED, changing this does nothing
Field.Description: Kept only so existing settings are not lost. Nothing reads this value. Mains Z-Wave health is judged by Indigo's own errorState instead, because lastSuccessfulComm on an un-polled mains node just tracks "time since last used" — an idle-but-alive light or repeater reads stale for days. Battery devices still use the threshold above.

Field.Label: Ecowitt state-change threshold (hours)
Field.Description: Alert if an Ecowitt device has had no state change for this many hours (uses lastChanged as a proxy).

Field.Label: Z2M device stale threshold (hours)
Field.Description: Device-level alert if a Z2M device has not communicated for this many hours. Generous by default so sleepy battery sensors are not flagged. (The plugin watchdog below uses its own minute-level thresholds.)

Field.Label: Quiet devices — sensors that are silent by design

Some sensors report only when something happens — a cupboard door that opens twice a week is healthy after days of silence, but every threshold above would call it offline. Give any such device a longer threshold of its own in quiet_devices.json (written on first run, in the same folder as the exclusions file). Entries take a device id or name plus a number of hours, or "never". Edits apply on the next scan, with no restart. A hard fault still alerts either way. Use "Show Quiet Devices" to see what is in force.
Plugin Watchdog — restart crashed or wedged plugins

Auto-discovers any plugin that owns comms devices and restarts it if it crashes (enabled but not running) or wedges (newest device comm older than its threshold). A denylist keeps native/virtual/derived/bridge plugins out; tuned thresholds apply where known. Policy is editable in watchdog_plugins.json (written on first run). Claude Bridge is always excluded.
Dry-run (log/alert only, no real restarts)
Field.Description: Leave ticked until you have watched a few cycles and confirmed the detections look right, then untick to allow real restarts.

Field.Label: Auto-discovered default stale threshold (minutes)
Field.Description: Wedge threshold for auto-discovered plugins that have no tuned override. Generous by default so a newly-seen plugin is never nuisance-restarted; tune individual plugins in watchdog_plugins.json.
